summary: Make every transformation auditable and prevent cleanup decisions from manufacturing apparent neural information.
outcomes: Build a justified preprocessing sequence with visible before/after checks.
Identify temporal, label and split leakage introduced by filtering or fitted transformations.
sequence: Inspect raw data and metadata first
Choose referencing, bad-channel handling and filtering
Track edge effects and event contamination
Fit learned preprocessing within the training split

visual.question: Did cleaning remove an artifact or the phenomenon of interest?
visual.interaction: Toggle processing stages and reveal known injected artifacts and true synthetic events.

practice.task: Repair a supplied pipeline containing an acausal leakage error.
practice.success: Demonstrates the error on a negative control and reports corrected grouped evaluation.
